spiritual.text: Ring the bells that still can ring. Forget your perfect offering. There is a crack in everything, that is how the light gets in.
spiritual.whyRecommended: A tender reminder that imperfection and vulnerability are where healing begins.

spiritual.text: Be patient with yourself. Nothing in nature blooms all year around. Allow yourself this season of resting and rooting.
spiritual.whyRecommended: Normalizes seasons of low energy and quiet rest.

humor.title: Samay Raina | India's Got Latent (Best Moments & Hilarious Acts)
humor.description: Samay Raina hosts India's Got Latent with unfiltered comedy, hilarious panel roasts, and wild contestant performances.
humor.whyRecommended: Unfiltered, belly-aching laughter that provides an easy, gentle distraction.

humor.title: Zakir Khan | Haq Se Single — Bus Safar & Small Joys
humor.description: Zakir's iconic bit on finding humor and self-worth in life's simple, awkward moments.
humor.whyRecommended: Deeply comforting humor that reminds you that you are enough.

humor.title: Anubhav Singh Bassi | Cheating & College Days
humor.description: Bassi's legendary, heartwarming storytelling about college friendships, exams, and mischief.
humor.whyRecommended: Infectious storytelling and pure warmth to lift heavy spirits.
